deep_observation: 漏译并改写关键句。原文 "I can't remember anything from the fight save the sheer terror at being near something so horrid and powerful" 中 save=except，威斯曼唯一记得的正是那份极度恐惧；译文「我完全不记得和那可怕怪物的战斗中发生了什么」整句删去 except 从句，使紧接的「在绝不可能获胜的敌人面前逃跑没什么可羞耻的」失去恐惧这一因果前提，并凭空增补原文没有的「抬起头来」。落款 "Wishing you and your ale a hearty good-bye" 是威斯曼启程猎杀怪物前向罗尔夫及其麦酒作别，译作「希望你能早日从醉生梦死中清醒过来」变成劝其戒酒，语用行为不同且 good-bye 全失；"if it takes me the rest of my life"（哪怕耗尽余生）亦被改成「宁死也要」。证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/lore/misc.lua，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，第 140-149 行 adventurer-letter-6（lore 正文 143-149）；麦酒指涉见同文件第 126-137 行 adventurer-letter-5，其第 135 行 "I shall be leaving for the tavern soon. Maybe I can drown the images of that monster in a sea of ale."
source:
Rolf,

I can't remember anything from the fight save the sheer terror at being near something so horrid and powerful. There is no shame in running from a foe you cannot possibly hope to defeat, is there? Maybe ale from the tavern is a good idea, but maybe it is better to conquer your fear once and for all... I hope you can forgive me, but I must defeat this monster, if it takes me the rest of my life.

Wishing you and your ale a hearty good-bye,

Weisman.
surface_observation: 原文仅向对方及其麦酒热情告别（Wishing you and your ale a hearty good-bye），译文却改成“希望你能早日从醉生梦死中清醒过来”，增加了原文没有的劝诫；原文还明确记得靠近怪物时的恐惧，译文“完全不记得”遗漏了这一例外。
target:
罗尔夫，

我完全不记得和那可怕怪物的战斗中发生了什么。抬起头来，在绝不可能获胜的敌人面前逃跑没什么可羞耻的兄弟，不是吗？去客栈喝麦酒也许是个好主意，但也许彻底战胜自己的恐惧才是更好的选择……原谅我的任性，这个怪物我是宁死也要打倒的。

希望你能早日从醉生梦死中清醒过来，兄弟，
威斯曼。

#{italic}#Touching the conch makes it emit a sound. As you put it to your ear you hear a lyrical voice emanating from within:#{normal}#

"Report from Tidewarden Isimon to Tidebringer Zoisla. Alucia and I have, um, begun scouting the outer perimeter. The, uh, the terrain is proving difficult to navigate, but I'm sure we'll make, uh, quick progress. We shall, uh, we'll continue now... in the name of the Saviour!

"...Um, you think that was okay?"

#{italic}#A second, lighter voice joins in.#{normal}# "Yeah, that was fine, Isimon. We'll make a Myrmidon of you yet!"

"Heh, I wouldn't be so sure of that... Guess I'll turn this off and we'll get going."

"Hey, what's the rush? This is the first time we've been alone from the others all week. Maybe we could..."

"What? Surely you don't mean-? What if someone comes along?"

"Oh, who would catch us out here? Come on!"

"I, uh, well, I suppose... I should stop this recording."
target:
#{italic}#触摸这只海螺可以使它发出声音。当你将它放于耳边时，你听到一阵悦耳如歌的声音从中传出：#{normal}#

"潮汐守卫艾斯蒙向潮汐使者佐西拉报告。艾露西亚和我已经，嗯，开始侦察外围了。这里，呃，这里的地形很难通行，不过我相信我们会，呃，很快取得进展。我们，呃，我们现在继续……以救世主之名！

"……嗯，你觉得这样行吗？"

#{italic}#另一个更轻柔的声音也响了起来。#{normal}# "嗯，很好，艾斯蒙。你迟早能当上侍从！"

"嘿，我可不敢肯定……我想还是关掉这个，然后出发吧。"

"哎，急什么？这可是整整一周以来，我们第一次避开其他人独处。也许我们可以……"

"什么？你不会是想——？要是有人过来怎么办？"

"哦，在这种地方谁会撞见我们？来嘛！"

"我，呃，好吧，我想……我该关掉录音了。"

deep_observation: "to a Warden, it represents the untapped potential of time" 意为「对时空守卫而言，它代表着时间尚未开掘的潜能」；译文「它将随着时间展现威力」改成了随时间成长的增强承诺，原文无此义，且与固定版本机制不符——ART_PAIR_TWSWORD 属性全为静态（combat dam=28/apr=10/physspeed=0.9、wielder 定值加成、talents_types_mastery 对 chronomancy/blade-threading 与 chronomancy/guardian 各 +0.1），唯一附加效果是与 ART_PAIR_TWDAG 的套装，无任何随时间或回合增长的机制。配对匕首 Dagger of the Past 以同一句式作 "it represents the opportunity to learn from the mistakes of the past"，与器物名 Sword of Potential Futures 共同印证 potential 指「潜能」而非「展现威力」。证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，第 2047-2101 行（desc 在 2054 行，talents_types_mastery 2080-2083，set_list 2085），配对匕首第 2103-2110 行。
source: Legend has it this blade is one of a pair: twin blades forged in the earliest of days of the Wardens. To an untrained wielder it is less than perfect; to a Warden, it represents the untapped potential of time.
surface_observation: 原文“it represents the untapped potential of time”表示这把剑体现时间尚未开发的潜能，译文“它将随着时间展现威力”改成威力随时间展现，改变了原意。
target: 传说这把长剑是一对兵器中的其中一个；这对兵器打造于时空守卫最初的年代。对于未经训练的持有者来说它还不是那么完善；对于时空守卫来说，它将随着时间展现威力。

deep_observation: "sliced" 译为「被切成薯片」，凭空引入原文没有的食品意象（薯片=potato chips）。该词条属 PHYSICAL 伤害类型的 death_message 表，运行时经 "if dt and dt.death_message then death_mean = rng.table(dt.death_message) end" 随机取出，填入 "%s the level %d %s %s was %s to death by %s%s%s on level %s of %s." 与对应 short_msg 的 was ... to death 槽位，槽内必须是「致死方式」的动词性短语；同表已另有 "chopped into tiny pieces"、"minced"、"splattered" 等碎块类词条，「切成薯片」与之语义重叠且不忠于 sliced（切开/劈砍）。证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/damage_types.lua 第 778 行 death_message 表，与 game/modules/tome/class/interface/PartyDeath.lua 第 71 行、107 行、115 行，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63。

deep_observation: "large chunk of wood"（一大块木头/木料）译为「巨大的树皮」，wood 与树皮（bark）是不同物料部位。该串是 WRATHROOT_SHIELD 的 unided_name，未鉴定态刻意用泛指的「大块木头」；bark 在同一条目中另有归属——鉴定后名为 Wrathroot's Barkwood，desc 为 "The barkwood of Wrathroot, made into roughly the shape of a shield."，barkwood 才对应树皮木。译成「树皮」既与源词 wood 不符，也与同条目 barkwood 的对应关系相混。证据：tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/general/objects/boss-artifacts-maj-eyal.lua，commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，第 580-587 行（unided_name 583 行，name 586 行，desc 587 行）。
